description: Wahanie, the spirit of hesitation at a crossroads: a living old wooden crossroads signpost, two arrow-shaped boards pointing two opposite ways like arms, a worried carved face on each board looking its own way, a split twisted grey post for a body standing on short root legs, wisps of grey mist around it, not a person, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the signpost alone, no ground, no background, the whole signpost inside the picture
